name: Fox Style (Combat, Style)
body:
Your flamboyant flourishes open gaps in your opponent’s defense while strengthening your own.

Prerequisites: Int 13, Combat Expertise, Improved Feint; base attack bonus +3 or Bluff 3 ranks.

Benefit: While using this stance, when you successfully feint an opponent you gain 20% concealment against melee attacks made by that opponent for 1 round. You cannot use this concealment to make Stealth checks.
